environment: local PostgreSQL with isolated PID-scoped template and scratch databases; EXIT trap cleanup enabled
privacy: synthetic UUIDs, course codes and stable mutation labels only; no prompts, answers, student content, emails, secrets or provider payloads retained
limitations: The /me/export assessment-user lock is an HTTP-layer invariant and is deliberately excluded from this SQL mutation package; its API and race coverage remains in the backend user-rights tests. This is not staging or production evidence.
